Subject: Renewal prep — SOC 2 re‑attestation + capacity ask

Jonas,

As we get closer to our November renewal I wanted to surface two items the security and procurement teams flagged: 1) updated SOC 2 evidence for re‑attestation (our auditors want a short bundle and log retention confirmation) and 2) a request to increase committed capacity from 10k to 25k inference hours per month for Q1 to support a promotional surge.

Can you confirm what evidence you can provide by 11/05 and whether the capacity increase can be reflected in a short amendment (term/committed units/pricing)? Procurement would like a DocuSign amendment if possible.

Thanks — Alex

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@bluemart.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal prep — SOC 2 re‑attestation + capacity ask

Alex — great to hear from you and not a problem. High level plan:

- SOC 2 evidence: we can deliver a curated evidence bundle (system configs, change control logs, most recent penetration test summary, control owner attestations, and a small sample of audit logs). Target delivery: 11/04 EOD to give your auditors time before renewal.
- Log retention: our default is 90 days for application-level audit logs and 12 months for control logs — we can provide a written retention statement and a sampled export (redacted) for your auditor.
- Capacity increase: we can provision a temporary bump to 25k inference hours for Q1. We propose a two‑part amendment: (a) short term capacity addendum for Q1 with prorated billing, (b) optional reserved commitment change if you want to make it permanent.

Next steps I propose: I’ll loop in our compliance lead to assemble a SOC 2 evidence bundle and our billing manager to draft a simple amendment + DocuSign. Can you confirm the exact auditor contact and whether they need FedRAMP‑style logs or standard SOC 2 Type II evidence?

I’m copying the internal folks who will move this: Marissa (security engagement / evidence), Neha (billing/contract), Hannah (ops for capacity).

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
(jonas_weber@redwood.com)
(attachment: billing‑info-request.docx)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Action: BlueMart renewal — evidence bundle + capacity request (RWD‑3421)

Marissa / Neha / Hannah — threading you in. BlueMart (Alex & Priya) requested SOC 2 re‑attestation artifacts by 11/05 and a Q1 capacity bump to 25k inference hours (current commit 10k).

Marissa: can you assemble a "minimal auditor bundle" with the following items? I believe this will satisfy their checklist:
- Evidence index (CSV) mapping control → artifact (who / what / when)
- Change control log export (last 12 months)
- Recent pen‑test summary (redacted vuln list ok)
- Control owner signed attestations (PDF)
- Sample audit logs (application auth events + system admin changes) — redacted PII

Neha: procurement wants a quick amendment with prorated billing for the Q1 surge and a DocuSign link. Can you draft a short amendment (term: Q1 2027; committed units: 25k for the quarter; uplift pricing: $0.XX per extra hour or flat prorated fee) and attach billing proposal v2?

Hannah: ops — can you validate if we can honor 25k without immediate dedicated capacity (we could do burst capacity with a 72‑hour notice window or reserve an additional pool). If a reserved pool is required, give lead time and cost estimate.

Timeline:
- 11/02: internal bundle ready for review
- 11/04 EOD: bundle & amendment sent to customer
- 11/05: customer to hand to auditors / sign amendment ideally

Attaching: evidence_index.csv (template) and an ops checklist.

Thanks — Jonas
